title: Activist charged with felony after giving border agent "duress code" that wiped his phone
summary: Tunick provided this code to an agent, who entered it on the phone, after which “the screen went blank, flashed several times and the phone appeared to restart.” All data on the phone was gone, but authorities confiscated it anyway.
